name_reason: Follows the data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention and reflects the datatype (a string resource filename). The 'fdmus_dat' suffix encodes the resource filename FDMUS.DAT (domain/semantic ID), not a Ghidra address residue (the address residue form would be _51a79, which is absent). No change needed.
purpose: Read-only ASCII C-string constant holding the resource filename "FDMUS.DAT" (the BGM/music sequence archive), passed as the fopen path when loading a MIDI/BGM track.
logic_summary: Stored as a 10-byte NUL-terminated string ("FDMUS.DAT\0"). The address is taken (PUSH 0x51A79) and passed as the first argument to fd2_load_dat_resource(filename, bgm_seq_buf, track_id), which fopen()s it ("rb") and loads entry [track_id] (a BGM sequence) into the BGM sequence data buffer; that buffer is then DPMI-locked and handed to AIL_init_sequence/AIL_start_sequence for MIDI playback. Sole reader is fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade @ 0x259F5. Never written.
element_semantics: Each byte is one ASCII character of the DOS 8.3 filename "FDMUS.DAT"; bytes[0..8] = 'F','D','M','U','S','.','D','A','T', byte[9] = 0x00 (NUL terminator).
notes: Content verified by read_memory: 46 44 4d 55 53 2e 44 41 54 00 = "FDMUS.DAT\0" (10 bytes), byte-identical to the src byte list at strtab.c lines 139-141. Sole xref confirmed via get_xrefs_to: fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade @ 0x259F5 [DATA]; decompile shows fd2_load_dat_resource(0x51a79,...). is_const=true: zero game-side write-xrefs (only the DATA read). Src comment (lines 131-141) already precise/accurate/ASCII -> comment_verdict=keep; strtab.c left unmodified. Ghidra PLATE_COMMENT was empty and the documentation lived in the deprecated PRE_COMMENT field; migrated a concise plate into PLATE_COMMENT and cleared PRE_COMMENT per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism (data plate must be PLATE_COMMENT) -> ghidra_plate_action=created. name kept (no Stage-2 rename queued).
